result.description: A fictional compact network appliance designed for studio audio routing, ambient control, and timed signal relay in creative workspaces. The LumenArc N7 Relay Console combines a fanless embedded controller with local 64 GB flash storage for presets, schedules, and diagnostic logs. It is intended for rack-adjacent use in small production rooms, podcast suites, and installation art environments. The device supports USB-C power delivery, dual Ethernet ports, and a simple web dashboard for configuration. Its low-power design emphasizes quiet operation and deterministic response for workflow automation rather than graphics or mass storage applications.
